g.title: Runs in the browser. Checks the random OAuth state that initiateOAuth() stored in sessionStorage, then sends the code to the token route. Token refresh in services/auth.ts goes through the same route.
Exchanges the authorization code, and later the refresh token, for tokens at Google using GMAIL_CLIENT_SECRET, which is never sent to the browser.
The sign-in redirect asks for the gmail.modify scope. The token endpoint serves the code exchange and refresh.
Holds the access and refresh tokens returned by the token route. They live in sessionStorage, so a closed tab signs the user out.
